method: Alternate baseline/head order per pair. Redeploy a unique marker for each sample. Accept only HTTP 200, matching marker, first request in its Worker isolate, same colo, reused TCP/TLS connection. The public /bench/api/lobby endpoint assigns a room via real D1 and Lobby bindings. Cold means Worker isolate, not cold D1 or cold room. Two version-specific Workers/DO namespaces share one D1 database and an identical minimal catalogue. Connections are pinned to the same colo; this is a controlled cold-isolate comparison, not a reproduction of the historical fresh-TLS PDX experiment.

bootstrap.interpretation: Exploratory percentile interval resampling adjacent deployment pairs; network and deployment conditions limit generalization.
